input.standard: ASTM E741 (concentration decay, single zone); ASTM D6245 (occupant CO2 as tracer)
input.purpose: Measure V_lab, the air volume served by scrubber-1-v10, as V = Qe * tau from a rise at reduced speed then a decay at full speed, hatch closed throughout.

steps.why: Rise: reduce scrubber effective flow to 0.3 m3/min so the occupant's CO2 lifts the Lab several hundred ppm above noise; 30 percent is the signed floor, never stopped.
Decay: full speed (Qe 1 m3/min); about one time constant (tau ~ 30 min for a first guess V = 30 m3). Record at 1 min intervals; fit C_eq + (C0 - C_eq) exp(-t/tau).

abort.when: CO2 of the Lab at or above limits.co2AbortPpm (3000 ppm)
the device refuses a step's speed command
battery state of charge under 40 percent
CDR out of band, monitoring lost, or one more person enters the Lab

monitoring.reason: CDR is the only occupant of the Lab, the volume whose CO2 the test raises.

hypotheses: The Lab is one well-mixed zone; the hatch (hatch-1-v10) stays closed during both steps, and the exchange through the closed hatch with Hab-B (design 3 m3/min per station-topology, 3 occupants there) is NOT measured: it is a hypothesis, checked by recording Hab-B CO2 (co2-2-v10); if it is significant the fitted tau gives an apparent volume biased from the true V.
Occupancy is held at 1 person (CDR, awake, 0.38 L/min, band 0.26-0.45); a person entering or leaving invalidates the curve.
Qe = 1 m3/min at full speed scales linearly with speed (datasheet: flow 3.3 m3/min x efficiency 0.3), with a scrubber lag of 3.33 min which is excluded from the first minutes of the fit.
First guess V = 30 m3 (shelf default, range 10-200) is only used to size the durations; tau = V/Qe.
Sensor co2-1-v10 is representative of the whole Lab, with noise well below a few hundred ppm.

expected.rise: With CDR alone and Qe = 0.3 m3/min, CO2 rises from 1450 ppm by roughly 200-400 ppm over 25 min (about 10 ppm/min initially) and stays under co2MaxPpm 2400.
expected.decay: After return to 100 percent, CO2 falls exponentially towards its equilibrium with tau = V/Qe near 30 min if V is about 30 m3 (tau 10-200 min for V 10-200 m3); fit gives V_lab = 1 m3/min x tau.
expected.hypotheses_hold: Hab-B CO2 stays flat or moves little and the fit residuals are small and unbiased.
expected.hypotheses_fail: A Hab-B CO2 that follows the Lab's, a fitted tau much shorter than V/Qe, a curve that is not a single exponential, or a rise that is faster than 13 ppm/min shows the opening exchanges air or the zone is not well mixed, and the V_lab is then only an apparent volume. The test stops if CO2 reaches 3000 ppm, the heart-rate band is breached, or a person enters the Lab.
